title: I found a photo of my apartment taken from inside my closet. I live alone.
transcript:
I found a photo of my apartment taken from inside my closet. I live alone. I bought a used film camera at a flea market, mostly for the look. There was still a roll inside. I thought it would be fun to develop it and see a stranger's vacation.

The photos came back on Friday. The first one was my living room.

I stood in the shop, trying to make sense of it. Same couch, same lamp, my blue mug on the table. Taken from low down, near the floor, in the dark.

The second photo was my kitchen. The third was my hallway.

The fourth was my bedroom, shot from inside the closet, through the gap in the door. In the photo I was asleep in my bed, one arm hanging off the side.

I counted the photos. Twenty-four. I was sleeping in all of them, but in each one, the closet door was open a little wider.

The last photo was different. It was taken from the bed, looking toward the closet. The door was wide open, and the closet was empty.

On the back, in pencil, someone had written tonight.

I'm in the bedroom now, and I'm holding the camera.

It has just advanced to the next frame.
